children: Siemens Energy's targets for fiscal 2027 and 2030 are all above market expectations, J.P. Morgan analysts write. The German maker of energy equipment gives a growth outlook that continues to cast shade on the rest of the company's the bank covers, the analysts write. Siemens energy is returning more than 25 billion euros of cash to shareholders by 2030, which represents around 24% of its market capitalization, they note. Shares rise 7% to 128.28 euros.(adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
